meta.title: Charisma30 — Build real charisma in 30 days
meta.description: A free 30-day program for calm presence, clear expression and real connection. One short lesson and one small practice a day. No account, no ads, no tracking.

hero.title: Charisma isn't a gift.
hero.lead: Charisma30 turns presence, expression and connection into one short lesson and one small practice a day — so the change actually sticks.
hero.shotAlt: Charisma30 Home screen: Day 6 of 30, the lesson Calm, Clear Voice, and today's practices

pillars.title: Each stage builds the next layer of your charisma
pillars.lead: You don't start by giving speeches. You start by feeling steady in your own body — then you learn to be heard, then to make people feel seen.

items.name: Presence
items.text: Calm body, steady eyes, a voice that doesn't rush. The foundation people feel before you say a word.

items.name: Expression
items.text: Say what you mean, clearly and credibly. Pauses, stories, getting to the point — and keeping a room with you.

items.name: Connection
items.text: Read people, listen for feelings, disagree with respect. The part that turns attention into trust.

how.title: Learn it. Practise it. Keep it.
how.lead: Every day follows the same simple rhythm, so you always know what to do when you open the app.

steps.d: Rate how you feel before the lesson — 1 to 5. You'll rate again at the end and see the difference.
A short guided lesson in clear steps, with flashcards and a quick quiz to make it stick.
Finishing the lesson unlocks small real-life habits you repeat over the next days.
The next lesson unlocks the next day. One step at a time is how charisma becomes natural.

how.shotAlt: Lesson screen: a before-rating from Tense to Calm and the four steps of the lesson

toolkit.title: Tools you keep, for the moments that matter
toolkit.lead: Some lessons unlock a reusable tool. Open it anytime — before a meeting, a date or a difficult call.

items.d: A guided breathing reset — in for 4, out for 6 — for 1, 3 or 5 minutes. Unlocks on Day 1.
A short reset for anxiety, tension or overwhelm: 5-4-3-2-1 senses, release tension, name the feeling, or STOP. Unlocks on Day 5.

toolkit.shotAlt: Presence Reset tool: a breathing circle with 1, 3 and 5 minute options

journey.title: The whole path, day by day

privacy.title: Your growth stays on your phone

items.d: Open the app and start. No sign-up, no email, no password.
Everything is stored on your device. No servers, no sync.
No analytics, no advertising networks, no third-party trackers.

items.a: Yes. The app is free to download and use, with no ads.

items.q: How much time does it take each day?
items.a: One short lesson plus small practices you fit into your normal day. Most people spend a few minutes on the practices and around a quarter of an hour on the lesson.

items.q: What if I miss a day?
items.a: Nothing is lost. Your next lesson waits for you — you simply continue where you left off. Your streak restarts, your progress doesn't.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: No. There is no sign-up. Your name, progress and habits are stored only on your phone.

items.q: Which languages is the app in?
items.a: English, Italian and French. You can switch language at any time in Profile → Language.

items.q: Is my data shared with anyone?
items.a: No. Charisma30 does not upload your data, and uses no analytics or advertising services. You can erase everything at any time from Profile → Reset Progress.

final.title: Start Day 1 today.
final.lead: Thirty days from now, you'll walk into the room differently.

footer.tagline: Calm presence, clear expression, real connection.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important. This policy explains how Charisma30 handles your data.

sections.p: All progress (completed days, name, avatar, habits and so on) is stored locally on your device. No data is uploaded to external servers.
The app does not collect or transmit your personal information. Any name you enter is stored only on your device.
Charisma30 does not use analytics tools, advertising frameworks or external tracking services.
You can erase all stored data at any time with the "Reset Progress" option on the Profile page, or by uninstalling the app.

This website uses no cookies and no analytics, and only remembers your language choice in your own browser. It is hosted on GitHub Pages and loads its fonts from Google Fonts, which receive your IP address to deliver the pages.
This policy may change as the app evolves. Continued use of the app means you accept the updated policy.
For questions or concerns, write to {email}.

terms.intro: By using Charisma30 you agree to these terms.

sections.p: This app is intended for personal development and educational purposes. You may not copy, resell or distribute its content without permission.

You are responsible for your own actions, decisions and well-being. Always use the techniques in safe, respectful contexts.
The app stores progress data locally on your device. No personal information is shared.
